mechanism: Echinacea may inhibit CYP3A4 and CYP1A2, potentially increasing paroxetine metabolism via CYP2D6 competition, while also carrying theoretical serotonergic activity that could augment SSRI effects.
action: Monitor patients for increased paroxetine side effects (nausea, dizziness, hyponatremia) and serotonin syndrome symptoms; counsel on echinacea use duration limits and consider alternative immune support.
